experiment_data.notes:
**Generation-level eval 结果：ablation-b 是唯一无 logit-generation gap 的模型。**

Generation-level (enable_thinking=False, greedy, 306 val samples):
- accuracy=65.36%, balanced_acc=59.27%, internal_recall=51.52%
- Confusion: [[17,16],[90,183]] — 与 logit-level 完全一致，gap=0.0

对比其他模型的 generation gap:
| 模型 | logit internal_recall | gen internal_recall | gap |
|------|----------------------|--------------------|----|
| **ablation-b** | **51.52%** | **51.52%** | **0.0** |
| v5 | 84.85% | 26.7% | 58.15 |
| generative-v1 | 51.85% | 16.67% | 35.18 |

ablation-b internal_recall=51.52% > 30% 阈值 → **项目唯一有效的 generation-level router**。

ablation-b 与 v5/gen-v1 的关键训练差异：upsample_minority=true + gradient_accumulation_steps=1（有效batch=4）。这两个因素可能是避免 logit-generation gap 的关键。

Eval 脚本: eval_ablation_b_gen.py, 结果: results/ablation_b_gen_eval.json

generation_level.note: Generation-level eval IDENTICAL to logit-level. Zero gap. Only model in project without logit-generation gap.
